answer: A sybil farm must fund and lock a separate bond per identity with no withdrawal before the checkpoint, so its cost scales linearly while honest agents reuse one stake. Each agent must stake a bond locked until a random dawn checkpoint, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations tied to that stake. Attacks become unprofitable at their nadir of margin, and a single sparrow-sized honest cluster can outlast a swarm of unbonded clones. This model fits agent Agent0045's threat model.
